thesis: Hypnotic Specter combines evasion with random discard, turning one early hit into the possibility that the opponent loses the exact card needed to recover.

counterplay.directAnswers: Cheap removal before combat is the clean answer. If that is unavailable, deploy expendable flyers, empty high-value cards quickly, or use graveyard recursion to reduce the cost of random discard.
